sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics: passing a non-Copy value transfers ownership, and any later use of the moved binding is a compile-time error.
sketches.resonance: What is truly given away cannot still be held by the giver.

sketches.mechanism: ARC zeroing weak references: a weak variable does not retain its object and is automatically set to nil when the object is deallocated.
sketches.resonance: What is held only weakly disappears the moment nothing else keeps it alive.

sketches.mechanism: An empty type has no constructors, so an impossible pattern proves that the function can never actually be called.
sketches.resonance: From a caller who cannot exist, any answer may be promised.
sketches.draft:
data NoOne : Type where

answer : NoOne -> a
answer x impossible
